en.description:
Tiny Slots is a slot machine for 30-second breaks on your wrist. Three emoji reels, one thumb, play money only. No accounts, no ads, no purchases, and no internet needed.

SPIN, HOLD, NUDGE
• Bet $10, $20 or $50 of play money per spin, or tap Stop to land the reels early.
• Hold up to two reels with lock credits to chase a triple. Hold two and only three of a kind pays.
• 25 spins without holds charge a Nudge. Turn the Digital Crown to slide the last reel one step and see exactly what it would pay before you commit.
• After a win, press and hold the ×2 chip to risk it on a 50/50, up to twice, on pots up to $1,000.

LUCK THAT COMES BACK
• One spin in twenty without holds is Lucky and multiplies its win by ×2 or ×3.
• Your first spin without holds each day is a Daily ×2 and punches a seven-hole card. The seventh daily spin is Golden ×5, and missing a day costs nothing.
• Drop below $10 and you get a fresh $1,000. Your best balance is kept.

MADE FOR APPLE WATCH
• Results have their own feel on the wrist: a click for even money, a tap for a win, a stronger buzz for a big win, and a drumroll while a double decides.
• Double Tap spins, stops or nudges on supported Apple Watch models.
• A warm gold cabinet with cream reels that stays readable in Always-On.
• VoiceOver reads every result. Reduce Motion is respected.

KEEP SCORE
• Stats track your best balance, biggest win, jackpots, nudges, doubles, Golden spins and a collection of all six triples.
• Help is one tap away, and Help and the winnings table always match the rules.

Tiny Slots uses play money only. It never asks for, and never pays out, real money.
en.releaseNotes:
Tiny Slots 2.0 is a new game on the same wrist. Your balance and best score carry over.

NEW LOOK
A gold cabinet with cream reel faces on a warm sunburst, and clean outlines in Always-On. It finally looks like its icon.

NEW WAYS TO PLAY
- Crown Nudge: 25 spins without holds charge a nudge. Turn the Digital Crown to slide the last reel one step, see the payout, tap to take it.
- Double Up: after a win, press and hold the x2 chip to risk it on a 50/50, up to twice.
- Bets of $10, $20 or $50.
- Punch Card: your first spin without holds each day is a Daily x2 and punches a seven-hole card. The seventh daily spin is Golden x5. Missing a day costs nothing.
- Tap Stop to land the reels early. Double Tap spins, stops or nudges on supported watches.

A REBALANCED TABLE
- Any pair returns your bet and a clover pair pays x2. Holding two reels pays only on triples, and held spins get no Lucky, Daily or Golden bonus. Your best score means something again.

MORE
- A Stats screen with your biggest win, jackpots and a collection of all six triples.
- Faster reels and a distinct feel for evens, wins and big wins.
- A spin is saved the moment you tap, so lowering your wrist never loses a result.
- Drop below $10 and you get a fresh $1,000, so a small bankroll never gets stuck.
- VoiceOver reads every result. Reduce Motion is respected.
- Help and the winnings table always match the rules.
